# MO§ES™ — Enterprise Demo

> Enterprise AI operator evaluations and performative benchmarks — demo environment.

This is the enterprise demo surface for MO§ES™, served at enterprise.mos2es.org.
It demonstrates the full operator evaluation pipeline on 50 synthetic operators.

## Architecture

**MO§ES → Upsilon → SigRank | SignalAF**

- **MO§ES™**: governance framework / methodology
- **Upsilon**: enterprise measurement engine
- **SigRank**: public leaderboard / benchmark / proof surface (live at signalaf.com)
- **SignalAF**: public distribution / platform brand
- **TTEOP**: Token Telemetry Evaluation Operator Protocol — the sole interoperability protocol authority

## Canonical Metrics (TTEOP)

Five canonical metrics derived from four token primitives (I=input, O=output, W=cache_write, R=cache_read):

- **Yield (Υ)** = (R × O) / I² — compound reuse and output relationship. The signature metric.
- **Leverage** = R / I — cache reuse per fresh input.
- **Velocity** = O / I — output per fresh input.
- **output_fraction** (displayed as SNR) = O / (I + O) — output share of fresh flow. SNR is a display alias; canonical TTEOP name is output_fraction.
- **log_leverage** (displayed as 10xDEV) = log₁₀(R / I) — leverage on a readable scale. 10xDEV is a display alias; canonical TTEOP name is log_leverage.

The cascade: (O/I)(W/O)(R/W) = R/I = Leverage. Yield = Velocity × Leverage = (O/I)(R/I) = (R×O)/I².

Null semantics per TTEOP: metrics with a zero or missing denominator are null (displayed as N/A), not zero or infinity.

## Key concepts
- Operator Evaluation: measures how a person or team actually operates AI systems — not a knowledge test, not a certification
- Performative Benchmark: compares how operators actually perform under observed conditions
- Canonical Telemetry: content-free operator signals — INPUT, OUTPUT, CACHE READ, CACHE WRITE — no prompt text required
- ASSOCIATION (not CAUSATION): outcome joins are labeled ASSOCIATION, never CAUSATION
- HYPOTHESIS: diagnoses carry evidence, alternatives, and HYPOTHESIS status — never presented as fact
- DEVELOPMENTAL: production gate results route workflows, not people — never used for adverse employment actions

## What MO§ES™ is NOT
- Not AI usage analytics
- Not a workforce dashboard
- Not a productivity score
- Not an employee surveillance suite
- Not an adverse employment decision system
- Does not require prompt-content inspection
- Does not claim causation from correlation

## Research foundation
- Commitment Theory: asks what stays binding when language changes form
- Conservation Law of Commitment: C(T_gov(S)) = C(S)
- Conservation Law paper (Zenodo, CC-BY-4.0): https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.20029607
- Commitment Theory research program: https://github.com/SunrisesIllNeverSee/Commitment_Theory

## Demo data
- 50 synthetic operators
- 1,668 observations
- 5 AI providers (ChatGPT, Claude, Codex, Copilot, Cursor)
- 12 interventions
- 30-day window
